title: Intrinsic Value Discovery
definition: The process by which an artificial intelligence identifies the inherent value or meaning in a given context.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Imagine a computer figuring out what really matters in a game, not just the score, but something else that leads to a better gameplay experience.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: The ability of an AI to identify and prioritize the intrinsic values within a given context, beyond the immediate objectives or outcomes.
difficulty_levels.expert: The AI's capacity to understand and focus on the underlying principles or meanings in a given context, rather than simply following prescribed rules or instructions.

extra_fields.insight: The AI is learning to identify the inherent value in a given context, rather than just following the rules or objectives.
